title: [FEATURE] Bring back ultrathink rainbow glow as easter egg
body:
Now that thinking budget is max by default, the ultrathink keyword does nothing.

The rainbow glow animation was a nice visual touch. Would be cool to keep it as a cosmetic easter egg - typing ultrathink triggers the rainbow effect even though it's functionally redundant.

Some of us have the sticker and miss the disco lights.
author: przadka

top_comments.author: vrdn-23
top_comments.body: +1 came here to see why no rainbow and thought my terminal was broken :(

top_comments.author: Giant-Space-Bee
top_comments.body: Please bring it back :) It's silly to take the magic away.
